content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ann Arbor

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented work history meet these thresholds before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Over a concentrated schedule, you'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategies—all delivered online so you can balance training with your current role in University of Michigan, Michigan Medicine, automotive, tech, or manufacturing.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee and allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before your scheduled exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam through PMI and take it at an approved testing center or online proctored environment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Every three years, earn and report professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, conference attendance, and active project work. Renew your credential with PMI to keep your competitive edge in Ann Arbor's project-driven employers.
